BiblicalUsage: Mizrach is the sunrise, the east — the direction the sun comes up and the quarter from which God's people look for Him. As far as the east is from the west, so far does He remove our transgressions; from the rising of the sun His name is great among the nations, and He promises to gather His children from the east.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the east is Scripture's picture of distance and of dawn together. Our sins are carried as far as the sun travels, and His mercy rises like the morning.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
